test_title: PYST 81: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The National Youth Policy 2014 defines youth as population between the ages of ________ and _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**15; 29**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The National Youth Policy 2014 categorizes youth as individuals aged between **15 and 29 years**.
 
• The policy aims to empower the youth of the country to achieve their full potential.
 
• This policy outlines the Government of India's vision towards the youth and their role in the nation's development.
 
• It focuses on key areas such as education, employment, entrepreneurship, health
